lines.text: The LORD tells Moses to take twelve staffs, one from each tribe leader, with Aaron's name on the staff of Levi.
Moses is to place the staffs in the Tent of Meeting, and the chosen man's staff will turn into a snake.
Moses lays twelve staffs before the LORD, and the next day Aaron's staff has buds, blossoms, and almonds.
Moses puts Aaron's staff back in front of the Testimony as a sign for the priests.
The Israelites cry out that they are perishing and ask whether anyone who comes near the tabernacle will die.
